features.name: Repo scaffold and toolchain
features.description: Makefile (setup/dev/test/style/build/clean), uv project, settings + logger, .env.example, .gitignore, git init + first commit. Everything else builds on this.

tests.notes: Smoke: make setup idempotent; make test/style run green on empty suite. 2 tests pass (settings + logger import/behavior).

features.notes: Build first; unblocks all other features.

features.name: Thread ingestion and PII redaction
features.description: Reconstruct threads from reply-ID chains (target + compact context), strip anon/URL noise, redact PII before any LLM prompt or committed artifact. Design node 1.

tests.notes: Chain walk incl. broken links; first-contact (55% unlinked); PII patterns never leak through

features.notes: Redactor is a graded-claim dependency (design entries 16, guardrail).

features.name: Intent classifier with calibration
features.description: Frozen embedding + linear head. Phase A: Banking77 clean ceiling. Phase B: weak-supervision adaptation on golden adapt-dev ONLY (entrypoint accepts dev slice path). Platt/temperature calibration + reliability data; threshold T from adapt-dev precision-coverage curve. Design node 2.

tests.notes: Hold-out import guard (training must fail on hold-out path); calibration improves ECE; 9-way output shape

subtasks.name: Banking77 Phase A training + clean ceiling
Phase B adaptation on adapt-dev only

features.notes: Needs F010 dev slice for Phase B. No LLM in this module, ever.

features.name: Thread-state machine
features.description: Cases A-D, keyword veto, continuation inheritance, (raw → override → final) logging. Design node 3 + §6 state block.

tests.notes: Each Case A-D; awaiting_user exception; veto on 'thanks + refund?'; inheritance only when low-conf; every decision returns/logs the triple. 11 tests pass.

features.notes: Pure logic, no LLM — fully testable offline. Feeds F009 override counts.

features.name: Per-intent retrieval grounding
features.description: Cluster historical brand replies within each intent into named response strategies (2-3 exemplars each); same-intent top-k retrieval at serve time. Design node 4c + §8.

tests.notes: Retrieval restricted to predicted intent; DM-takeover clusters present for money intents

features.notes: Needs F002 intent labels for clustering corpus.

features.name: Reply drafter (Groq)
features.description: LLM call site #1. Free-draft policy for social-only threads; grounded policy (intent + history + exemplars + strategy as hard context) otherwise. Temperature 0, model recorded, artifacts cached.

tests.notes: Mock the LLM client; assert prompt contains intent + exemplars for grounded policy and omits them for free policy

subtasks.name: Artifact caching keyed by (provider, model, prompt hash)

features.notes: Needs GROQ_API_KEY at runtime; tests run on mocks. Never add classification logic here.

features.name: Judge as gate and critic (Gemini)
features.description: LLM call site #2. One call, multi-criteria rubric (groundedness / tone_policy incl. PII-leak / escalation-correctness + shift-aware check), rationale per verdict; failures return critique for ≤3 retries, then escalate. Different provider from drafter by construction.

tests.notes: Mock client; PII-echo draft must fail; retry loop caps at 3 then escalates with rationale as handoff note

subtasks.name: Gemini client + rubric prompt + rationale parsing
Gate/critic loop with retry cap and drop-to-escalate

features.notes: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY at runtime. Rubric text versioned; old rubrics retained.

features.name: Pipeline orchestration
features.description: The DAG only: ingest → classify → gate/state → draft/retrieve → judge → serve/retry/escalate. No business logic; stage boundaries stay 1:1 portable.

tests.notes: End-to-end on fixtures with mocked LLM sites; each Case A-D path exercised

subtasks.name: DAG wiring with typed state dict

features.name: Baselines
features.description: Trivial (majority intent + canned reply) and simple (TF-IDF retrieval draft) baselines on the same hold-out. Unbeaten slices feed failure analysis.

tests.notes: Baselines run offline with zero LLM calls

features.notes: Independent of F005/F006 — buildable in parallel.

features.name: Metrics and agreement
features.description: Accuracy/macro-F1 on raw + final labels, override counts, per-intent counts with CIs, auto-handle precision, judge specificity, Case-B wrong-close recall — every metric sliced by Case/continuation/veto/shift flags. Kappa + bootstrap CIs (pairwise raters + judge-vs-majority vs mean−2σ bar).

tests.notes: Kappa on a known table; bootstrap CI contains point estimate; slicing preserves counts

features.notes: Pure local math — no LLM, no keys. Buildable in parallel with F001-F003.

features.name: Golden set build
features.description: 150-250 threads at 60/20/20 (real/boundary/adversarial), reply chains preserved, PII-redacted, 70/30 adapt-dev/locked-hold-out split, written rationales on every escalate/fail, author-adjudicated. Plus blank rater sheets for the 3-rater protocol (15 calibration + ~50 main).

tests.notes: Stratum mix enforced; hold-out untouched by training (F002 guard test lives here too); zero unredacted PII patterns in committed files

features.notes: Human-labelling effort lives here; blocks F002 Phase B and all headline numbers.

features.name: Cache-first repro harness
features.description: LLM artifact cache + `make build` reproducing headline numbers from cache with a small live smoke subset (<15 min with keys set). Loud failure without keys.

tests.notes: Cache hit avoids client call; key mismatch (provider/model/hash) invalidates

subtasks.name: Cache read/write keyed by (provider, model, prompt hash)
make build: cache repro + smoke subset

features.name: Report
features.description: docs/report.md (≤6 pages): framing + non-goals, results vs both baselines, top-5 failures with real examples, 'misleading headline' section, next-week plan, decision log. Built from F009 outputs, not hand-written numbers.

tests.notes: Checklist test: every mandatory brief section present; every number traceable to an eval artifact

subtasks.name: Fill from eval artifacts + failure analysis

features.notes: Last feature. Numbers must match committed eval artifacts exactly.
